c74object.name: zerr.disperser~
c74object.digest: Disperse a mono source over the speakers, each channel shaped by its envelope
c74object.description: Use the zerr.disperser~ object as the last stage of the Zerr* chain: it disperses a mono source over the loudspeakers by multiplying it with a multi-channel envelope set, one output channel per envelope. The envelopes come from zerr.envelopes~ or zerr.combinator~; the output goes to mc.dac~ or on to further multi-channel processing.

inlet.description: The signal to disperse over the loudspeakers. It must be mono: a multi-channel source silences the output, so sum or pick a channel first.
One envelope per loudspeaker, from zerr.envelopes~ or zerr.combinator~.

outlet.digest: The source on every speaker channel, scaled by its envelope
outlet.description: A multi-channel signal with one channel per envelope: the source scaled by that loudspeaker's envelope. Connect it to mc.dac~.

method.name: signal
method.description: The mono source in the left inlet, the multi-channel envelopes in the right inlet.

c74object.discussion: The channel count follows the envelopes, not a layout file: change the layout argument of zerr.envelopes~ and zerr.disperser~ adapts on its own; nothing is set here. The envelopes are gains and are not limited: zerr.envelopes~ stays within 0 and 1, but if you build envelopes yourself, values above 1 boost and negative values flip the phase. The object takes no arguments and has no messages beyond the signals.

entry.name: multi-channel signal
entry.description: The source on every loudspeaker channel, each scaled by its envelope.
